content:
We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have IR spectrum data: wavenumbers list includes 3109 etc, but no carbonyl stretch (~1700 cm-1). The list includes 1588, 1577, 1502. No ~1700. So likely zero carbonyl groups.

But we need to be sure. Could be missing data. Could also use other spectra like carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). We can request carbon NMR.
